chunks: And who is more astray than he who calls upon those, besides Allah, who do not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, while they are unaware of his call.
ai.seo_question: Why are idols or false gods considered ineffective in responding to prayers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to critique both idolatry and the elevation of saints or imams to divine status, emphasizing that true intercession requires Allah's permission. The phrase 'oblivious to their supplications' highlights the ontological limitation of created beings, distinguishing between the absolute power of Allah and the dependent nature of all other entities. This reinforces the concept of Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah, ensuring that worship remains directed solely to the Divine.
